name: enzyme
description: Set up and keep Enzyme fresh for local knowledge vaults

interface.shortDescription: Set up semantic memory for your vault
interface.longDescription: Enzyme scans a local Markdown or Obsidian vault, confirms the entities and exclusions to persist, initializes the local index, and keeps it fresh while the app runs.
defaultPrompt: Set up Enzyme for this vault.
Scan this vault and confirm what to index.
